title: Locality, ancestry and the closing exception on the ordinary growing end
claim: Does a fixed growing-end radius determine the next funded ordinary update, including its fresh counts and parity closure?
standard_statement: For complete updates of finite incidence structures, ask whether a bounded neighborhood in the witness-intersection graph determines a child star including its degree, and bound the distances between descendants under the intersection operator.
prior_work: Full-roster reconstruction and the identified finite-piece closure/relay alternative are known in the program. The literature treats intersecting maximal cliques; held sets, unary births and global parity closure require a separate argument.
completion_gate: If the all-reading obstruction is verified inside the proved class, stop the epic in Stage 1 and report. All later stages are gated.

validation.status: Fresh independent operator cross-check and literal state enumeration conducted in the same task. Independent program referee pending.

source_contribution: Proposed separation of complete-roster determinism from local determinism; conditional distance comparison and explicit test of raw-source inclusion.
attained_result: No finite shared-parent radius determines the next funded parity birth in the identified class; small local demand bounds and exact inclusive descendant distances survive.
